client.tagline: Building trust, one project at a time
client.business_description: A family-owned general contractor specializing in residential remodels, custom home builds, and commercial tenant improvements across the region.
client.design_style: Professional, grounded, trustworthy — solid and established, not flashy
client.avoid: No neon colors, no overly modern or playful styling
client.content_owner: Client provides project descriptions; designer polishes copy
client.media_owner: Client has a strong library of jobsite and finished-project photos

sections.notes: Sticky nav, logo left, phone number as an amber CTA button on the right — make it easy to call.
Use a large finished-project photo on the right. Client has strong media — let it carry the section.
Three pillars: Residential Remodels, Custom Homes, Commercial. Keep copy short and concrete.
Before/after project photos build credibility fast — feature 6 of the best.
Family-owned story + team photo. Emphasize years in business and licensing.
Two strong client quotes with names and project type.
Bold amber band: 'Ready to start your project?' with a single Request a Quote button.
Simple quote-request form: name, email, phone, project details. Keep it short to maximize submissions.
Logo + license number, quick links, and contact info. Repeat the phone number.
Short headline: 'Let's build something great together.'
Full quote form plus office address and hours beside it.

reference_insights: Lead with a full-bleed project photo and keep the phone number visible at all times — credibility and an easy path to contact are doing the heavy lifting.

reference_details.nav_pattern: Sticky top nav, logo left, 4 links right, phone number rendered as a colored CTA button.
reference_details.hero_pattern: Full-bleed finished-project image with a short headline overlay and a single primary CTA.
reference_details.content_pattern: Alternating image-text rows for services and about, with a 3-column project/service grid below the fold.
reference_details.cta_pattern: Persistent phone number top-right plus a recurring 'Request a Quote' band between sections.
layout_principles: full-bleed hero with one clear CTA
reference_details.what_to_borrow: The always-visible phone CTA paired with large, real project photography that proves the quality of work.
reference_details.what_to_avoid: Avoid stock-photo gloss — this client's own jobsite photos are more convincing than polished stock imagery.

constraints: No neon or playful styling. Keep typography classic and the layout uncluttered so the brand reads as established and dependable.
designer_summary: Quest Construction is a family-owned contractor that wants to feel solid, credible, and easy to contact. Lean on their strong project photography and keep a calm navy/amber palette with classic type. Watch-out: avoid anything trendy or flashy — trust is the priority, and the phone CTA should never be more than a glance away.
palette_rationale: A deep navy anchors the brand with stability and professionalism, while a warm amber accent adds approachability and draws the eye to calls-to-action against the soft off-white background.
font_rationale: Libre Baskerville gives headlines a classic, dependable authority, paired with the highly readable Source Sans 3 for clean, modern body text.
